tools.name: list_data
tools.description: The indexes and sourcetypes with events in the last 24 hours, with their event counts, most first (at most 60 lines of "index  sourcetype  count"). Use it first, to know where to look.

tools.name: field_summary
tools.description: The fields of one index and sourcetype, from 5,000 recent events: each field's name, how many events have it and its number of distinct values, at most 40, most common first. Use it before naming any field in a search.

tools.name: sample_events
tools.description: Up to 6 recent raw events of one index and sourcetype, each of a different shape, cut to 600 characters, with email addresses replaced by <email>. Use it to see what the fields hold.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: The tables in this app's database, with their columns: the searches the user loaded and kept. Use it first, to know what there is to read.

tools.name: read_rows
tools.description: Up to 50 rows of one table, from offset, optionally ordered by a column. Use it to look at the data itself; page through with offset rather than asking for everything.
